items.text: Nashik is India's wine capital - Sula Vineyards and a real, growing viticulture and wine-tourism industry around Gangapur and Dindori - and, at the same time, home to HAL's Ozar aircraft-manufacturing division, which puts the city inside India's aerospace and defence-manufacturing map alongside a serious auto-ancillary manufacturing belt at Satpur and Ambad MIDC.

Good counselling here means building the high-value skill portfolio that fits your actual track - not the one that sounds most familiar - so it can move you toward the decisions that unlock high income opportunities and earlier financial freedom.
You can start from home, from a college near College Road, or from work near Satpur, Ambad, or Ozar - no travel required before the underlying skill direction is even clear.
